question: At the 78th World Health Assembly in May 2025, how many countries voted in favour of the historic WHO Pandemic Agreement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**124 countries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **78th World Health Assembly (WHA)**, held in **May 2025**, marked a historic turning point in global health governance with the formal adoption of the **WHO Pandemic Agreement**.
 
• A total of **124 countries** voted in favor of the accord, providing the necessary support to establish a legally binding framework for future pandemic prevention, preparedness, and response.
 
• The agreement was adopted under **Article 19** of the **WHO Constitution**, which empowers the Assembly to create conventions or agreements to protect global health.
 
• The primary focus of the **124 countries** supporting the agreement was to rectify the **inequities** witnessed during the **COVID-19 pandemic**, specifically concerning the distribution of **vaccines** and **diagnostics**.
